propositions: review-bot container requires bedrock credentials via the existing instance role; currently the role grants only ssm read and kms decrypt, with no bedrock permission

the grant must authorize bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream (NOT bedrock:Converse), scoped to anthropic.claude foundation models and *.anthropic.claude inference profiles, because the converse api checks invokemodel action at runtime despite being a distinct simulatable iam action
imdsv2 token reachability from inside the review-bot container determines the implementation path: iam-only if imds succeeds (default), or conditional http_put_response_hop_limit=2 if it fails

a new scoped inline policy in infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf (NOT modifying iam.tf per single-owner contract) attaches to rebar-gerrit-instance-role and must be verified with role-scoped simulation plus a real converse call from the instance, never from an operator identity holding bedrock:*
the story is deliberately decoupled from the downstream bedrock cutover (story eb6e); it enables credentials only and does not redirect rebar's llm calls from anthropic to bedrock
